mostWorthwhile.text: Combining bone cells with blood vessels was most worthwhile: the picture showed nutrients reaching living bone cells through tiny channels, while blood cells stayed in the vessel.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the cartilage caps was predictable, and the result added little to the initial picture.

surprise.text: I was interested to see how nutrients reach bone cells without blood cells leaving the vessel.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures gave the parts clear roles, though some later combinations were the only available option.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see more body parts assembled, although I would hope for less predictable steps.
